name: disenchanter
source:
Welcome to the Forest Exorcism Shop.
It’s become so popular lately that there’s barely any time to rest.
Even on Halloween, it’s business as usual.
Today’s appointments: three clients――

Listen to their troubles and help them out.
There are four endings in total, including game overs.
translation:
欢迎来到森林驱魔店。
最近它变得如此流行，几乎没有时间休息。
即使在万圣节，一切照旧。
今天的约会：三位客户——

倾听他们的烦恼，帮助他们解决问题。
包括游戏结束在内，共有四种结局。
